A tiny settlement that lives at the edge of your screen and grows through the ages. Nothing is ever demanded of you: no timers, no penalties. When something needs a decision, a small light bulb appears and waits for you.

**Windows 10/11, 64-bit.** Unzip and run `TinyAges.exe`. No installer. `README.txt` in the zip explains how to play.

- **SmartScreen:** the build isn't code-signed, so Windows may say the app is unrecognised. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Your save** is in `%APPDATA%\TinyAges\`. Delete it to start over.
- **Checksum:** the `.sha256` file is attached (SHA-256 of the zip).
- **Quit:** right-click the strip, then Quit (or press `Q`).

MIT licensed. Made with Godot 4.7.
